recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞比例偏高，可見晚期正染紅血球母細胞呈雙核（兩顆等大濃縮核，如下方中央）及成對相連的中期紅血球母細胞，提示晚期紅血球母細胞多核化的先天性紅血球生成異常貧血第二型（CDA II）。
features: Cellular aspirate with numerous erythroid precursors at intermediate and late stages (round nuclei, clumped chromatin, blue to grey-pink cytoplasm)
Binucleate late erythroblasts with two equal-sized condensed nuclei (bottom center) and closely paired erythroblasts
Maturing myeloid cells present (myelocyte, band and segmented neutrophil) and a large macrophage with granular debris-laden cytoplasm
Multinucleation in this single field is limited; the full binucleate/multinucleate frequency cannot be judged from one view
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with prominent erythroid precursors, including intermediate and late erythroblasts. Several late erythroblasts are binucleate with two equal-sized condensed nuclei, and occasional erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours. Granulocytic maturation is present, and a macrophage with granular cytoplasmic debris is seen, consistent with ineffective erythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS) in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation relies on SEC23B sequencing, band 3 hypoglycosylation (SDS-PAGE) or electron microscopy showing peripheral double membranes.

ddx.vs: Shows internuclear chromatin bridges between erythroblasts and spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin on electron microscopy, with binucleated cells less prominent than in type II.
Occurs in older adults with multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than a lifelong inherited anemia.
Erythroblasts show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin, and hypersegmented neutrophils and giant metamyelocytes are present.
Features giant multinucleated erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei and autosomal dominant KIF23 mutation, rather than predominantly binucleate late forms.
